note: Gated RV area on the Cloverdale Citrus Fairgrounds, within walking distance of downtown Cloverdale just off US 101. Run by the Cloverdale Citrus Fair. Island spaces suit longer coaches; the Arcade spaces are compact back-ins. No campfires; generators only with permission. --Claude
summary: Cloverdale Citrus Fairgrounds RV: passes the fairground test (ordinary nights sold year-round on its own Skedda calendar; closed only for the Citrus Fair Jan 29 - Feb 22, 2027 and posted events). $40 W/E Arcade / $45 FHU Island + tax, dual 30/50 A, 4 pull-through Island spaces, Arcade under 30 ft; showers, wifi, dump; max stay 14. Site count not stated (engine not read). Phone confirmed.
